_note: B61 repair café: states & conditions (adjectives). English sound-alike hooks acted on each item.

fr_intact_adj.hook: The big white teapot came through every repair in one piece: still INTACT, not a single chip.

fr_polonais_adj.hook: The blue-dotted Polish mug gets POLISHED till it shines – a POLISHED POLISH mug (po-lo-NAY).

fr_infini_adj.hook: The toy train runs round its figure-eight track for ever – an INFINITE loop (an-fee-NEE).

fr_innombrable_adj.hook: The jar is crammed with buttons – far too many to put a NUMBER on: IN-NUMBER-ABLE, countless.

fr_soigne_adj.hook: The porcelain SWAN sits so neat and tidy you'd cheer 'SWAN – YAY!' (swahn-YAY): beautifully neat and well-kept.

fr_humide_adj.hook: The kettle steams and the towel beside it drips: everything here is HUMID and damp (oo-MEED).

fr_fragile_adj.hook: The tall stack of china plates teeters – careful, they're FRAGILE!

fr_net_adj.hook: The butterfly NET has been washed spotless: a perfectly clean, NEAT NET (net).

fr_liquide_adj.hook: The golden glue pours out of the bottle into the pot – runny, LIQUID (lee-KEED).

fr_use_adj.hook: This old boot has been USED so much its toe has worn right through (oo-ZAY).

fr_poussiereux_adj.hook: The feather duster PUSHES the dust off the old book in a grey puff – so dusty!

fr_menager_adj.hook: The iron and the little broom are the household MANAGER's kit for all the house jobs (may-na-ZHAY).

fr_incomprehensible_adj.hook: Nobody can work out this tangle of springs and gears – it's INCOMPREHENSIBLE.

fr_desert_adj.hook: The dolls' house is so DESERTED that DESERT sand drifts through its empty rooms (day-ZAIR).

fr_fixe_adj.hook: The desk lamp has been FIXED firmly in place with a screw clamp – it can't move (feeks).

fr_urgent_adj.hook: The red bell rings and rings: it's URGENT, come quickly (oor-ZHAHN)!

fr_casse_adj.hook: The CASSErole dish has cracked clean in two: broken (ka-SAY).

fr_souple_adj.hook: The SOUP ladle bends like rubber – a SUPPLE, bendy SOUP-le ladle.

fr_disponible_adj.hook: The gumball DISPENSER is full and ready to give one out – available (dees-po-NEEBL).

fr_fini_adj.hook: The toy fish is FINished – its shiny FINs are the last coat of paint (fee-NEE).

fr_pris_adj.hook: A coat and a PRIZE rosette sit on the chair – that seat is already TAKEN (pree).

fr_provisoire_adj.hook: The chair leg is tied up with wire just for now – a PROVISIONAL fix until the proper repair (pro-vee-ZWAHR).

fr_illegal_adj.hook: The ILL EAGLE with a bandaged wing flies anyway – that's against the rules, ILL-EAGLE-al (ee-lay-GAL)!

fr_mobile_adj.hook: The MOBILE of paper birds swings and moves at the slightest breath (mo-BEEL).

fr_interesse_adj.hook: The boy peers through his magnifying glass, so INTERESTED in the pocket watch (an-tay-reh-SAY).

fr_temporaire_adj.hook: The umbrella is patched with sticky tape – a TEMPORARY fix (tahm-po-RAIR).

fr_pret_adj.hook: The girl presses her hands together as if to PRAY (preh): her mended bike is READY!

fr_libre_adj.hook: The cage door is open and the canary is LIBERATED – FREE at last (LEE-bruh).

fr_malade_adj.hook: Teddy has a MALADY: tucked up with a hot-water bottle and a thermometer, he's ill (ma-LAD).

fr_frais_adj.hook: The strawberries glisten with dew – FRESH-picked, so FRESH (freh).

fr_gauche_adj.hook: 'GOSH!' – the boy's LEFT elbow knocks the button jar flying: so clumsy (gohsh).

fr_sauvage_adj.hook: Wild flowers burst out of the old kettle like a SAVAGE jungle (so-VAHZH).

fr_complet_adj.hook: Every piece is in: the jigsaw is COMPLETE (kom-PLEH).

fr_continu_adj.hook: The knitted scarf goes on and on and on – one CONTINUous scarf (kon-tee-NOO).

fr_boueux_adj.hook: 'BOO!' – these BOOTS are so muddy they'd scare you (boo-UH): muddy boots.

fr_reserve_adj.hook: A ribbon ties off the little armchair: it's RESERVED for someone special (ray-zair-VAY).

fr_impur_adj.hook: The water in the jar is cloudy with bits floating in it – IMPURE (an-POOR).

fr_pacifique_adj.hook: The baby's PACIFIER rests on its soft blue blanket – peaceful, PACIFIC (pa-see-FEEK).

fr_aride_adj.hook: The earth in the cactus pot is cracked and bone dry – ARID (a-REED).

fr_vacant_adj.hook: Nobody lives in the little birdhouse – it's VACANT (va-KAHN).

fr_integral_adj.hook: The wholemeal loaf is whole, not one slice cut – complete, INTEGRAL (an-tay-GRAL).

fr_fluide_adj.hook: The silk ribbon flows in a smooth wave, like a FLUID (flu-EED).

fr_terrien_adj.hook: The little globe shows our TERRA, the Earth – everything earthly (tair-YAN).

fr_restant_adj.hook: One last biscuit is left, and an ANT is RESTing beside it: the REST-ANT biscuit, the remaining one.

fr_lyonnais_adj.hook: A little toy LION sits in the crate – a LION from LYON (lee-o-NAY).

fr_oral_adj.hook: A toothbrush and toothpaste: everything for your mouth – ORAL care (o-RAL).

fr_operationnel_adj.hook: The old fan whirrs round, fully working again – OPERATIONAL (o-pay-ra-syo-NEL).

fr_respectif_adj.hook: Each cup sits on its own saucer – on its RESPECTIVE saucer (reh-spek-TEEF).

fr_gele_adj.hook: The JELLY has gone hard and frosty – FROZEN JELLY (zhuh-LAY).

fr_manquant_adj.hook: One piece of the jigsaw is MISSING – there's a hole where it should be (mahn-KAHN).

fr_infidele_adj.hook: IN-FIDDLE: the violin's string has snapped and it won't stay true to its tune – unfaithful, disloyal (an-fee-DEL).

fr_introuvable_adj.hook: The man is IN TROUBLE: he can't find his glasses anywhere – they're on his own head! Impossible to find (an-troo-VAHBL).

fr_inexistant_adj.hook: The picture frame holds nothing at all – the picture is NON-EXISTENT (ee-neg-zee-STAHN).

fr_compatible_adj.hook: The plug slots perfectly into the socket – they're COMPATIBLE.

fr_defectueux_adj.hook: The DEFECTIVE toaster flings the toast up into the air (day-fek-tu-UH).

fr_incompatible_adj.hook: The square peg will never fit the round hole – INCOMPATIBLE.

fr_intermittent_adj.hook: The bulb flickers on… off… on – INTERMITTENT light (an-tair-mee-TAHN).

fr_defaillant_adj.hook: The wind-up ANT keeps FAILING and toppling over: DE-FAIL-ANT, failing (day-fa-YAHN).

fr_inactif_adj.hook: The radio is switched off and the cat sleeps on it – both INACTIVE (ee-nak-TEEF).
